[Council File 17-0193-S10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CONSIDERATION OF MOTION (YAROSLAVSKY – HERNANDEZ) relative to the Fiscal Year 2026-27 payment of Enterprise Agreement No. 00309465 with Esri for geographic information system (GIS) software and maintenance support services.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. REQUEST the Controller to transfer, as soon as possible, the following amounts from the following participating City departments and bureaus identified below, totaling $4,420,833.00 to the Engineering Special Services Fund, Fund No. 682/50, Appropriation Unit No. TBD – Citywide Enterprise License Agreement-ESRI, Inc., so that the Bureau of Engineering (BOE) can make full payment of the annual payment to Esri for its special GIS-related services.
